purpose: Turn the screened v6 hybrid artifact into a small importable and command-line transparent tensor program with exhaustive domain, rejection, dependency, and provenance conformance tests.

interface.task14: predict native or edited donorward margin from direction, E/A/U/W membership, and optional edit
interface.bracket: predict edited donorward margin from supplied native margin and recipient/donor closer IDs
interface.cli: one JSON request to one JSON response; no model or network access

predictions.pred_a_hash_bound_load_and_inventory: The executable refuses a changed artifact and loads exactly 6+10+6 numeric scalars.
predictions.pred_b_exhaustive_task14_conformance: All 160 Task14 native/edit combinations exactly match the frozen equations and reject malformed directions/backgrounds.
predictions.pred_c_exhaustive_bracket_conformance: All nine ordered/self pairs over five finite baselines exactly match frozen equations and reject malformed closer IDs.
predictions.pred_d_dependency_and_import_boundary: The executable imports no model, torch, transformer, facade, network, or training module; Task14 has only semantic/edit inputs and bracket additionally declares one native baseline scalar.
predictions.pred_e_evidence_and_scope_manifest: A hash-bound release manifest preserves the v2 combined null, v6 screen, prospective metrics, exact composition counts, 22-scalar price, and all closed whole-model/full-logit claims.

terminal.null: Any failed hash, equation, rejection, dependency, provenance, or scope gate blocks release without altering scientific artifacts.
